prompt.text:
Implement `Solution.java` as a deterministic grid-fleet engine. Define public enums `Orientation { HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL }` and `Shot { MISS, HIT, SUNK, REPEAT }`, plus an opaque public nested class `Board`. Expose public static methods `Board createBoard(int size)`, `void place(Board board, String start, int length, Orientation orientation)`, `Shot attack(Board board, String cell)`, `boolean allSunk(Board board)`, and `String[] renderShots(Board board)`. Board sizes are 2 through 26. Coordinates use one uppercase row letter followed by a one-based decimal column with no leading zeroes, such as `A1`. Reject nulls, malformed or out-of-range coordinates, invalid lengths, placements extending beyond the board, and overlapping ships with `IllegalArgumentException`; rejected placements must not mutate the board. Each placement creates a distinct ship. An attack returns `REPEAT` when its cell was previously attacked, otherwise `MISS`, `HIT`, or `SUNK` when that attack hits the final unhit cell of its ship. `allSunk` is false for a board with no ships. `renderShots` returns independent row strings using `.` for untried cells, `o` for misses, and `x` for hits, without revealing unhit ships.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
